description: This file defines a React context and provider component for managing theme (light/dark) state in a web application. It includes context creation, state management with localStorage persistence, theme toggling, and a custom hook for consuming the theme context.

methods.name: applyThemeToDom
methods.description: Applies the specified theme to the document by adding or removing the 'dark' class on the root element.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: React component that provides theme context, manages theme state with localStorage persistence, and applies theme to DOM.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: Custom hook to access theme context; throws error if used outside ThemeProvider.
